## About
PaRu Roofing and Construction is a general contractor based in San Antonio. We do residential and commercial roofing, home remodeling and additions, and fences and decks. No project is too big or too small.
You'll get to know Paul, Ruben and the crew. One customer wrote that Paul came to the house, looked over the roof damage and was "honest in his quote." Another said Paul was "very responsive and thorough throughout the entire process."
We're licensed and insured, and we hold a 4.9 rating from 144 Google reviews. We'd be glad to come out and take a look at your project.

## Services
- Residential Roofing: Asphalt shingle roofs from GAF, Owens Corning and CertainTeed, plus standing seam metal and tile roofs for local homeowners.
- Commercial Roofing: New roofs and roofing repairs for commercial buildings, including Versico EPDM and TPO roofing, standing seam metal and tile.
- Home Renovations: Kitchen and bath remodels and home additions, whether you're making your dream home or getting ready to sell.
- Fences & Decks: Wood and vinyl fences, pergolas and gazebos, decorative outdoor features, and metal, composite or cedar decks. We'll also handle small repairs on an existing fence or deck.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free quotes?
A: Yes. Call us or fill out the contact form and we'll set up a free quote for your project.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: San Antonio, Alamo Heights, New Braunfels, San Marcos, Stone Oak, Helotes, Seguin, Castroville, Boerne, Floresville, La Vernia and Spring Branch.

Q: Which shingle brands do you install?
A: We're certified installers of Owens Corning, CertainTeed and GAF shingles.

Q: Will you take on a small repair?
A: Yes. Even if you only need a small fix on an existing fence or deck, give us a call.
